downgradeModal.title: Switch to the Free plan?
downgradeModal.intro: If you switch to Free, you'll immediately lose access to exclusive Pro features:

items.projects: Unlimited projects — limited to 2 active projects
items.estimatesQuotes: Unlimited estimates and quotes — limited to 5 estimates / 2 quotes per month
items.pdf: Professional PDF without watermark — reverts to ElectricalVPF watermark

downgradeModal.autoText: The Free plan has been successfully activated, but you keep the Pro plan benefits until the current paid period ends.
downgradeModal.autoTextDated: The Free plan has been successfully activated, but you keep the Pro plan benefits until {{date}}.

switchMonthlyModal.title: Confirm switch to monthly billing
switchMonthlyModal.body1: You won't be charged now. Confirming only changes your billing direction — your plan switches to monthly, with no additional charge at this time.
switchMonthlyModal.body2: From your next renewal, you'll pay €14.90/month instead of €143.04/year. Your new renewal date will be updated on the card after confirmation.
switchMonthlyModal.errorDefault: Could not process the switch to monthly billing.
switchMonthlyModal.errorRetry: Could not process the switch to monthly billing. Try again.

switchYearlyModal.title: Confirm switch to yearly billing
switchYearlyModal.body1: You won't be charged now. Confirming only changes your billing direction — your plan switches to yearly, with no additional charge at this time.
